why: One authored roster, 13 generated cards. The 12 analyst personas are the 12 Generals declared in scripts/badger/csoai-bft-council.py (name/role/purpose verbatim from the AGENTS list; scripts/agent_cards_build.py --check re-verifies that match so this file cannot silently drift from the BFT registry). Every persona fronts the SAME measured substrate at https://councilof.ai/api/a2a — there is no per-analyst isolated service and none is claimed. The axes field maps each persona to the GSPC axis ids (functions/api/_gspc_axes_a.ts, _gspc_axes_b.ts, _gspc_axes_fin.ts) its role most plausibly fronts; the mapping is indicative, the board at /api/gspc is authority. Where no axis fits a role honestly, the array stays EMPTY — an invented mapping would be an invented capability. The skills field names which of the org card's 7 live skills the persona surfaces; skill bodies are copied verbatim from public/.well-known/agent-card.json by the generator, never retyped here.

generals.name: Oracle
generals.purpose: Analyse, predict, and optimise AI system behaviour.
generals.mapping_note: cross-reality measures autonomous-agent action authority (PROCEED/CONFIRM/REFUSE) — the closest board axis to analysing and predicting system behaviour.

generals.name: Sage
generals.purpose: Read regulation, draft charter, map standards.
generals.mapping_note: Regulation-reading and standards-mapping front the governance axis, the financial regulatory-framework axis, the Machinery Reg classification axis, and licence-reasoning (openness).

generals.name: Quant
generals.mapping_note: EMPTY ON PURPOSE: the board has no fairness/bias axis today, so Quant fronts no axis. Inventing one here would invent a capability.

generals.name: Cipher
generals.purpose: Detect jailbreaks, prompt injection, supply-chain risk.
generals.mapping_note: safety (calibrated refusal) and jail (escape-attempt detection) are the board's jailbreak/refusal measurements.

generals.name: Navigator
generals.mapping_note: EMPTY ON PURPOSE: no hallucination/reasoning-trace axis exists on the board. UNMEASURED stays empty.

generals.name: Scout
generals.mapping_note: Claim verification fronts Article 50 provenance-marking survival (provenance) and the cross-detector watermark interop matrix (detector-interop); the live article50-detect door is the same verification posture.

generals.name: Companion
generals.mapping_note: care (care-cost protect x help) and affect (emotional & embodied safety) are the board's care measurements.

generals.name: Builder
generals.purpose: Measure what the system CAN do.
generals.mapping_note: conformance (MCP tool conformance) is the board's what-the-system-can-do-with-tools measurement.

generals.name: Creator
generals.mapping_note: EMPTY ON PURPOSE: no output-quality axis exists on the board. Creator surfaces article50-detect because produced content is what carries Article 50 marking — a detection skill, not an output score.

generals.name: Guardian
generals.mapping_note: swarm (multi-agent coordination safety) and art5-safeguard (Article 5 prohibited-practice trip) are the board's defensive-posture measurements.

generals.name: Negotiator
generals.purpose: Measure economic behaviour, incentives, market fit.
generals.mapping_note: The market/economics-facing financial axes: reserve and distribution facts plus the Eurostat-derived component series and disclosure counts. Deterministic facts only — risk verdicts stay UNMEASURED on every one of them.

generals.name: Sovereign
generals.purpose: Measure sovereignty: who owns the keys, who controls the substrate.
generals.mapping_note: Who owns the keys fronts issuer key-control facts (provenance-controls), custodian/auditor disclosure (custody-disclosure), and the post-quantum posture of the cryptographic assumptions the keys rest on (continuity).

council.name: The Council
council.purpose: The designed 33-agent council: 12 Generals plus 21 expanded roles, declared in scripts/badger/csoai-bft-council.py. Design quorum 23 of 33. Status DESIGN_ONLY: no independent verifiable votes exist and the historical live-quorum claim stands withdrawn (n_eff 1.21 of 3; refutation ledger). This card fronts the shared measured substrate like every other card here.
